items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I said, just go ahead and play and I'll play with you, which I did.

ctx.x: And, it was a lovely tour; it was the

first time I had ever seen Switzerland, but this time - when I went back - I had played for George Wein in Nice and, of course, George always puts things on the bulletin board everyday where you're suppose to appear and the second thing I did in that-- of that particular day, I think it was the second day of the concert thing, I was to play with Hans Zurbrugg's Wolverines; of course, I've never even heard of them let alone play with them. So, I went down there and stood around and they're playing and they were a…
You just fit yourself in with them?
